item.name: 07 — Files
item.description: Upload never passes through the API: the PUT here goes straight to the blob store on another host, so the session cookie is not sent with it. Run in order — later requests reuse ids captured earlier.

exec: // A minimal but real PDF: the API trusts the stored content type, not this text
pm.test('rejected before any URL is signed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('upload'));
pm.test('files share the folder naming rule', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('VALIDATION_ERROR'));
pm.test('a foreign folder is indistinguishable from a missing one', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('FOLDER_NOT_FOUND'));
pm.test('an unused name starts a new document', () => pm.expect(body.mode).to.eql('NEW_FILE'));
pm.test('the browser gets a signed URL, never a token', () => pm.expect(body.upload.url).to.be.a('string'));
pm.test('the URL carries its own expiry', () => pm.expect(Date.parse(body.upload.expiresAt)).to.be.greaterThan(Date.now()));
pm.test('the object key never leaves the API', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('objectKey'));

item.name: PUT signed URL — bytes go straight to storage

exec: // Nothing here touches our API: this is the 4.5 MB function body limit being bypassed
pm.test('only a HEAD check can produce READY', () => pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('READY'));
pm.test('size came from storage, not from us', () => pm.expect(Number(body.sizeBytes)).to.be.greaterThan(0));
pm.test('bytes cross as a decimal string, because BigInt breaks JSON', () => pm.expect(body.sizeBytes).to.be.a('string'));
pm.test('the first version becomes current', () => pm.expect(body.isCurrent).to.eql(true));
pm.test('the same version answers, nothing new is created', () => pm.expect(body.versionId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('versionId')));
pm.test('a READY version makes the row visible', () => pm.expect(file).to.not.eql(undefined));
pm.test('the listing carries size and type', () => pm.expect(Number(file.sizeBytes)).to.be.greaterThan(0));
pm.test('a taken name versions the document instead of failing', () => pm.expect(body.mode).to.eql('NEW_VERSION'));
pm.test('the stored name wins over the uploaded casing', () => pm.expect(body.name).to.eql('Contract.pdf'));
